mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" browses TUNEPS's public tender listing (newest published, or open-only sorted by soonest deadline). "Detail" fetches one or more specific tenders by their internal TUNEPS bid id.

openOnly.title: Open only (mode=list only)
openOnly.description: When true, only returns tenders whose submission deadline hasn't passed yet, sorted soonest-deadline-first. When false (default), returns all publicly-published tenders sorted most-recently-published-first.

keyword.title: Keyword filter (mode=list only)
keyword.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the tender's French title (accent-insensitive on TUNEPS's own server, e.g. "hopital" matches "Hôpital"). Leave blank to return all tenders.

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many tenders this run returns. The actor pages through TUNEPS's listing (up to 100 per request) until this cap is reached or no further tenders match.

bidId.title: Bid id (mode=detail only)
bidId.description: A single tender's internal TUNEPS id (the 'epBidMasterId' field from a 'list' mode run), e.g. 134251.

bidIds.title: Bid ids (mode=detail only)
bidIds.description: Multiple bid ids to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many bid id lookups to run in parallel.
